card.line: En-gedi was a city in the wilderness of Judah near the Dead Sea, where David hid from King Saul and spared his life.

moments.title: David hides in En-gedi
moments.text: David went up and lived in the strongholds of En-gedi. Saul was told that David was in the wilderness of En-gedi.

moments.title: David spares Saul in the cave
moments.text: Saul went into a cave near En-gedi, where David and his men were hiding. David cut off a corner of Saul's robe, but he would not harm the LORD's anointed and held his men back.

moments.title: Enemy army at En-gedi
moments.text: Men told King Jehoshaphat that a vast army was coming and was already at Hazazon-tamar, which is En-gedi. Jehoshaphat sought the LORD and called Judah to fast.

moments.title: Fishermen by the fresh river
moments.text: Ezekiel saw a river from the sanctuary that makes the waters fresh. Fishermen would spread their nets from En-gedi to En-eglaim.
